description: This Java source file defines the class WorkEffortContentWrapper, which provides methods to retrieve, process, and render content related to work efforts within the OFBiz framework. It implements the ContentWrapper interface and includes mechanisms for caching, content retrieval by type or ID, and content rendering as text.

classes.name: WorkEffortContentWrapper
classes.description: Implements ContentWrapper to facilitate retrieval and rendering of content related to work efforts, with caching and content type filtering capabilities.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves work effort content as text, optionally using cache and encoding.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Fetches the content ID of the most current content of a specified type.

methods.name: getContentName
methods.description: Gets the name of the most current content by type.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the fromDate timestamp for the latest content of the specified type.

methods.name: getDataResourceId
methods.description: Fetches the data resource ID associated with the latest content of a given type.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of content texts for a specific content type.

methods.name: getTypeDescription
methods.description: Provides the description of the specified content type.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves specific content by content ID with options for cache usage and encoder.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve content with default cache setting.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContentAsText
methods.description: Static method to convert work effort content to text, with overloads for request and locale.

methods.name: getFirstWorkEffortContentByType
methods.description: Fetches the most recent content matching a specific type for a work effort.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContentTextList
methods.description: Provides a list of content texts for a work effort's content type.

methods.name: makeWorkEffortContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of WorkEffortContentWrapper from a work effort and request.
